description: Put a static site online on a free link. Pass files inline as {path, content, encoding} where encoding is utf8 or base64. This server cannot read a folder on your machine. The server chooses index.html, dist/, build/, out/, _site/, .output/public or docs/. If the files are source code, run the build and call deploy_site again on the output folder. With a token: pass site (its address, from list_sites) to update that site. Omitting site fills the oldest reserved address on the account (from Get an AI code) instead of creating a second site. Without a token the site goes live anonymously and you MUST give the human the claim_url. Free only; never buys a name. Decoded files stay within the upload cap: 100 MB and 5,000 files when signed in, 25 MB and 1,000 files before the site is claimed. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

files.description: Site files sent inline. Each item has path, content, and encoding utf8 or base64. Leave out node_modules, .git and hidden files. .well-known is allowed.

content.description: File contents. UTF-8 text, or standard base64 when encoding is base64.

path.description: Relative path, for example index.html or css/site.css.

site.description: Optional: the address of an existing site to update, e.g. myproject.dropthehassle.app (from list_sites). Omit it to fill the oldest reserved site on this account.

slug.description: Optional: the address label for a NEW site, e.g. "myproject". Errors when taken, so propose another.

name: deploy_site
